steps.title: Inspect and Clean Build Environment
steps.description: Analyze existing gradle setups and strip out unauthorized NanoHTTPD third-party dependencies from build.gradle for absolute native compliance.

steps.title: Implement Premium 3D Multi-Tone Linear Gradients
steps.description: Add dynamic programmatic linear gradient render shaders directly inside ThreeDCalculatorView.java to generate rich 3D specular lighting and metallic look.

steps.title: Optimize 3D Retro Wave Horizon Sky Shader
steps.description: Introduce custom triple-color neon cosmic linear gradients on ThreeDLoaderView.java rendering pipeline to produce space-depth horizons.

steps.title: Establish Dynamic Background and Panel Gradients
steps.description: Integrate programmatic GradientDrawable adapters in MainActivity.java to style the general screens and digital screens with glowing cyan neon strokes.

steps.title: Configure UI Component Elements with Identifiers
steps.description: Update activity_main.xml layout elements with descriptive IDs (root_layout, display_container, header_bar) to facilitate custom programmatic drawing styles.

steps.title: Ensure Audio Synthesizer Stability
steps.description: Validate physical memory allocation and sample rate handling for standard click frequencies in SoundSynth.java.

steps.title: Validate Local SharedPreferences Logging
steps.description: Check the state storage mechanism in HistoryManager.java to ensure historical logs survive state disruptions.

steps.title: Optimize Text-to-Speech Engine Signature
steps.description: Confirm the parameters inside MainActivity.java for safe, non-deprecated usage with Android SDK 34 targets.

steps.title: Review AndroidManifest Configuration
steps.description: Validate namespaces and relative MainActivity class assignments inside AndroidManifest.xml.

steps.title: Building ThreeD Calculator
steps.description: Assemble complete resources and compile sources to produce the final enhanced debug packages.
